cd /workspace && python3 << 'EOF'
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
def paras(n):
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    for p in re.findall(r'<w:p\b.*?</w:p>',d,re.S):
        t=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',p,re.S))
        if t.strip(): yield t
print("=== document.xml ===")
for t in paras('word/document.xml'): print(repr(t))
print("=== header1 ==="); [print(repr(t)) for t in paras('word/header1.xml')]
print("=== footer1 ==="); [print(repr(t)) for t in paras('word/footer1.xml')]
# leftover check across all parts
import re as _re
leftover=[]
for n in z.namelist():
    if n.endswith('.xml'):
        d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        txt=_re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',d)
        for m in _re.findall(r'\{\{[^}]*\}\}',txt): leftover.append((n,m))
print("LEFTOVER:",leftover)
EOF

cd /workspace && python3 << 'EOF'
# Unit-test the conditional + missing-field logic using fill.py internals
import importlib.util, json, re, tempfile, os
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fill","fill.py")
f=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(f)

cond_para='<w:p><w:r><w:t>{{IF_RELO</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:t>CATION}}Relocation allowance: {{RELO</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:t>CATION_AMOUNT}}.{{END_IF_</w:t></w:r><w:r><w:t>RELOCATION}}</w:t></w:r></w:p>'

def res_factory(d):
    def r(name, conditional=False):
        return str(d[name])
    return r

# Case A: governor Yes -> keep
d={'RELOCATION_PACKAGE':'Yes','RELOCATION_AMOUNT':'4,125','RELOCATION':'No','RELOCATION_PACKAGE_BACKUP':'Yes'}
out=f.transform_paragraph(cond_para,res_factory(d))
txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',out))
print("Yes     ->",repr(txt))

# Case B: governor No -> remove (RELOCATION=Yes must NOT act as alias)
d2={'RELOCATION_PACKAGE':'No','RELOCATION_AMOUNT':'4,125','RELOCATION':'Yes','RELOCATION_PACKAGE_BACKUP':'Yes'}
out=f.transform_paragraph(cond_para,res_factory(d2))
txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',out))
print("No      ->",repr(txt))

# Case C: 'yes' lowercase -> remove (exact match only)
d3=dict(d); d3['RELOCATION_PACKAGE']='yes'
out=f.transform_paragraph(cond_para,res_factory(d3))
txt=''.join(re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',out))
print("yes     ->",repr(txt))
EOF
